## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed 332 reads during the period, recording 488 hours of work. This represents a rate of 0.7 reads per hour. The workload was documented for review, with the recorded hours and reads providing the basis for the assessment.

## Quality

A total of 21 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The agreement rate was 47.6 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistency in the reading process.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
